item.title: 75 Songs to Celebrate Spain’s World Cup Victory: Rosalía, Quevedo, Enrique Iglesias & More
item.description:
Here's a short and engaging podcast script:
[Upbeat music plays in the background]
Host: "The 2026 FIFA World Cup may be over, but the celebration continues! Spain has taken home the coveted golden cup, defeating Argentina 1-0 in the final match. To keep the party going, Billboard has curated the ultimate playlist, 'Spain's World Cup in Music'."
[Short clip of "Macarena" by Los Del Rio plays]
Host: "This playlist features 75 songs and over four hours of music, including some of Spain's biggest hits like 'Macarena', 'Aserejé', and 'Bailando'. You'll also hear classic gems like 'Y Viva España' and tracks from legendary artists like Julio Iglesias and Shakira."
[Short clip of "La Graciosa" by Quevedo and Elvis Crespo plays]
Host: "And, of course, no playlist would be complete without some of the newer tracks making waves on the charts, like 'La Graciosa', which is currently number one on Billboard's Spain Songs chart."
[Short clip of "Bonito" by Jarabe de Palo plays]
Host: "So, if you're missing the World Cup festivities, don't worry! You can relive the excitement with Billboard's 'Spain's World Cup in Music' playlist. Listen to it now and keep the celebration going! Olé!"
[Music and announcer continue for another 5 seconds before fading out]
